triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER provider_webhooks_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON public.payment_provider_webhook_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prohibit_financial_record_delete()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prohibit_financial_record_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Financial records cannot be deleted.';
end;
$function$
triggers.name: provider_webhooks_no_delete
